description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractBinary' for binary expression nodes in the Twig templating engine. It provides constructor logic with deprecation warnings for type checks and a compile method to generate PHP code for binary operations.

classes.name: AbstractBinary
classes.description: An abstract class representing binary expressions (e.g., addition, subtraction) in Twig, providing constructor validation and a compile method for code generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the binary expression with left and right nodes, issuing deprecation warnings if the parameters are not instances of AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the binary operation, invoking the 'operator' method to insert the operator token.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to specify the operator (e.g., '+', '-', etc.) for the binary expression.
